about.comments: Comments appear immediately. Moderators can hide abusive comments afterwards. Your browser creates a key for you the first time you comment; back it up to keep your identity.
about.p1: AzaadAwaaz is a news platform that can't be taken down. Invited contributors write stories; one moderator's approval publishes them.
about.p2: Every published story is copied to several independent networks (IPFS, Arweave, Nostr relays) and gets a receipt on public blockchains. No single company, server or domain holds the only copy.
about.privacy: No ads, no tracking, no analytics. This site makes no requests to third parties. We don't record IP addresses.
about.title: About AzaadAwaaz
about.verify: Every file is identified by its fingerprint (hash) and every story is signed. Press Verify on any story to see each check run live in your browser.
